newsitem.title: USA: Atchison Casting Corp Q2 Dec 31 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Atchison Casting Corp Q2 Dec 31 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1995 Q2 net includes gain of $513,000 or $0.06 a share from flood insurance proceeds and losses following the acquisition of Canadian Steel Foundries in Montreal and during the start-up of Amite Foundry & Machine in Louisiana.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1995 six months net includes gain of about $10.3 million or $1.15 a share from flood insurance proceeds and losses incurred following acquisition of Canadian Steel Foundries in Montreal and during the start-up of Amite Foundry & Machine in Louisiana, as well as by the conversion of a portion of the production at the Atchison/St. Joe Division from military to commercial castings.
